rule: `run` refuses, before reading the contract or computing anything, if the --outdir path already exists (file or directory, empty or not); exit status 2; message 'REFUSED: output directory exists ...' on stderr; nothing is created or modified. No overwrite option.
where: rnpbench_report/cli.py (Report itself), so rnpbench-report, python -m rnpbench_report, python -m rnpbench_predict and rnpbench report run behave identically
not_changed: the analysis modules and the library functions agreement.write and report.write (used by the internal qualification tools) are unchanged
difference_from_other_tools_disclosed: Evaluate and Diagnose refuse when their own output FILES already exist in the directory; this Report rule, as instructed, refuses when the DIRECTORY exists
regression_tests: rnpbench-report/tests/test_output_protection.py: pre-populated and empty existing directories, through each entry point; asserts exit 2, identical bytes and mtimes of every pre-existing file, no added file
